passage.title: Library opening hours announcement
passage.transcript: Hello everyone. Starting next week, the community library will stay open until eight in the evening on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We are making this change because many students and workers asked for more time to study after school and work. All other opening hours will remain the same.

learning_path_questions.prompt: [MOCK 003] What change is the speaker mainly describing?

options.text: The library will close on weekdays.
The library is moving to a new building.
The community library will open later on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
The speaker is announcing a new language course.

learning_path_questions.explanation: The announcement focuses on extending the library's evening hours on two days. (Câu mẫu được sinh tự động để kiểm thử giao diện và luồng dữ liệu.)

passage.title: Saturday workshop details
passage.transcript: A reminder about Saturday's writing workshop: it begins at nine thirty in the morning in Room 204. Please bring a notebook and arrive ten minutes early. If you have not registered yet, complete the online form before Friday evening.

learning_path_questions.prompt: [MOCK 002] Which room should participants go to?

options.text: The workshop begins at 8:30 a.m. on Sunday.
The workshop begins at 2:00 p.m. on Friday.
The workshop begins at 9:30 a.m. on Saturday.
The workshop begins at 10:30 a.m. on Monday.

learning_path_questions.explanation: The speaker directly states that the workshop begins at nine thirty on Saturday morning. (Câu mẫu được sinh tự động để kiểm thử giao diện và luồng dữ liệu.)

passage.title: A shared neighborhood garden
passage.text: Last spring, residents turned an unused corner beside their apartment building into a shared garden. Families now grow vegetables, children learn about plants, and neighbors meet while watering the beds. The garden has not solved every problem in the area, but it has made the space greener and helped residents feel more connected.

learning_path_questions.prompt: [MOCK 002] Which title best summarizes the text?

options.text: Residents are planning to move to a different apartment building.
The city has banned families from growing vegetables.
A shared garden has improved a local space and brought neighbors together.
The passage explains how to build a large shopping center.

learning_path_questions.explanation: The passage describes the garden's benefits for the neighborhood and its residents. (Câu mẫu được sinh tự động để kiểm thử giao diện và luồng dữ liệu.)

question_pool_passages.title: Library opening hours announcement
question_pool_passages.transcript: Hello everyone. Starting next week, the community library will stay open until eight in the evening on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We are making this change because many students and workers asked for more time to study after school and work. All other opening hours will remain the same.

question_pool_passages.title: Saturday workshop details
question_pool_passages.transcript: A reminder about Saturday's writing workshop: it begins at nine thirty in the morning in Room 204. Please bring a notebook and arrive ten minutes early. If you have not registered yet, complete the online form before Friday evening.

question_pool_passages.title: Planning a community fair
question_pool_passages.transcript: Maya: I can contact the food stalls and prepare the refreshment area. Ben, could you finish the posters and send them to the community center? Ben: Sure. I'll send the final design this afternoon. We should meet again on Thursday to check the schedule together. Maya: Good idea. The fair is on Saturday, so we need everything ready by Friday.

question_pool_passages.title: A change in the weather
question_pool_passages.transcript: The sky has become very dark, and the weather report says there may be heavy showers this afternoon. I left the clean cushions on the balcony earlier. I'd better bring them inside before I start cooking dinner.

question_pool_passages.title: Invitation to a neighborhood clean-up
question_pool_passages.transcript: I'm really pleased with how much our neighborhood has improved this year. On Sunday, we're holding another clean-up at the riverside park. Even an hour of your time can make a difference, and it's a great chance to meet your neighbors. I hope many of you can join us!

question_pool_passages.title: A shared neighborhood garden
question_pool_passages.text: Last spring, residents turned an unused corner beside their apartment building into a shared garden. Families now grow vegetables, children learn about plants, and neighbors meet while watering the beds. The garden has not solved every problem in the area, but it has made the space greener and helped residents feel more connected.

question_pool_passages.title: Weekend book exchange notice
question_pool_passages.text: The Green Street book exchange will take place this Sunday from 8:30 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. in the community hall. Visitors may bring up to five books in good condition. Entry is free, but anyone who wants a table must register by Thursday using the library website.

question_pool_passages.title: Comparing two travel plans
question_pool_passages.text: Plan A costs less because travelers use the public bus, but the journey takes about forty minutes longer. Plan B uses a direct train and is quicker, although the ticket costs more. Both plans arrive before noon, so the best choice depends on whether travelers prefer to save money or time.

question_pool_passages.title: Saving water at home
question_pool_passages.text: During the dry season, families are encouraged to conserve water. Simple actions such as turning off the tap while brushing teeth and fixing leaking pipes can reduce waste. These habits may seem small, but they help protect local water supplies over time.

question_pool_passages.title: Small changes in a community
question_pool_passages.text: A clean street does not depend only on a large city budget. When shop owners keep the pavement clear, residents sort their rubbish, and neighbors report broken lights, a street can become safer and more pleasant. These actions may take little time individually, yet together they can make a meaningful difference.
